status: P0 terminal diagnostic provenance fixed; generation quality and retry policy unchanged
problem: After a real first-draft spelling rejection, a later Scope or resource stop could leave validation_error in the attempt history. Report.finish inferred the final outcome from that stale field and incorrectly wrote validation_rejected.

behavior.terminal_provenance: Private typed metadata is set only when returning the actual source-preparation validation error, final prose validation error, or incomplete-response error after ready/cancel/resource/time checks.
behavior.observed_result: Report.finish receives the actual final Result. An unclassified later error remains deferred; no resource/transport category is guessed from text.
behavior.fallback: Each real with_cpu_fallback operation clears provenance before budget/admission. The wrapper has no intervening fallible spawn/prepare path.
behavior.persistence: A failing finish_job clears provenance; actual committed, cancelled and commit_failed priorities remain. A successful commit is not undone by a later diagnostic/job-write failure.
behavior.attempt_history: Original validation_error, attempts, usage and deduplicated validation_failed trace events stay intact. No new draft/error-body trace fields.
behavior.error_identity: Original anyhow errors are moved back unchanged, without marker wrappers or new display/context text.

observed.source: actual Terms.validate_writer_names first error retained after real Scope.check or Generation.ready resource stop

behavioral_red.limitation: Control proves production diagnostic terminal-cause misclassification; not a new model run or quality claim. No hold/cache/prompt/validator/parameter changes.

scope_limits: Only notes.rs and notes/diagnostic.rs changed. Request objects, templates, validators, parameters, quotas, scheduler and default model are unchanged.

Tests use real temporary Engine/store, real spelling validator, real Scope check after note edit and Generation.ready resource-stop control. They do not prove model quality or native hardware pressure behavior.
Additional actual fallback-counter/Budget and real SQLite write-failure controls check provenance resets; neither is a real GPU failure test.

No model/native qualification, Q16 rerun, model download, SDK/GPU archive/installer build, or release CLI rebuild. The prior restored CLI is not the new source identity and must be rebuilt before future real-model testing.

The proposed automatic same-input hold/failure cache was not implemented: complete runtime/component/driver invalidation identity is not closed. InputDigest and weak worker epoch are not substituted for that requirement.
Existing reports/failures/costs are not rewritten. Q16 and0.3.5 release gates remain open.
independent_review: Parent verified every frozen source/artifact SHA and read production changes. Separate read-only reviewer checked all terminal/fallback/commit points and reported no blocking issue.
release: Stable0.3.4;0.3.5 unpublished; this is diagnostics fidelity, not a Q16 or whole-resource optimization completion claim.
